property_summary: Deposits accumulate: after any two Put calls of amounts a1 and a2 by the same actor, Acc(actor).balance equals a1+a2; the mutant overwrites the balance with the last amount, violating this for any a1>0.
change_summary: Replace `acc.balance += msg.value;` with `acc.balance = msg.value;` so each deposit overwrites instead of accumulating the caller's balance, observable via the public Acc mapping.
